title: Integral derived pullback, completed tensor product and internal Hom
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring
$\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and put
$A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$, with the reductions
$A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a
scheme $W$ let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_W$ be the completed
coefficient sheaf on the small pro-etale site $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ the derived
category of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules and
$\operatorname{Res}_n$ the restriction of scalars along the projection
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}\twoheadrightarrow(A_{E,n})_W$
[def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]; $\operatorname{Res}_n$ is exact
[lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact], so it is applied termwise to complexes.
Since $\pi_n$ is $\pi_{n+1}$ followed by $(A_{E,n+1})_W\to(A_{E,n})_W$, a map of
$(A_{E,n+1})_W$-module complexes $C'\to C$ with $C$ an $(A_{E,n})_W$-module complex is
a map $\operatorname{Res}_{n+1}C'\to\operatorname{Res}_nC$ of
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-module complexes.

**Resolutions and reductions.** For $K\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ choose a
quasi-isomorphism $P\to K$ from a K-flat complex [def-pc-kflat-complex] of
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules with flat terms (it exists
[lem-pc-kflat-resolution]), and put
$P_n=P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}(A_{E,n})_W$ (termwise change of rings
[def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]); $P_n$ represents the derived reduction
$K_n=K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$
[def-weil-integral-derived-reduction], and it is a K-flat complex of
$(A_{E,n})_W$-modules with flat terms [lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings]. The
reductions induce maps of complexes $P_{n+1}\to P_n$.

**Derived limits.** For a tower $(C_n,t_n:C_{n+1}\to C_n)_{n\geq1}$ of complexes of
$\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules, $R\varprojlim_nC_n$ is the derived limit
[def-weil-derived-limit] in $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, represented by
$\operatorname{Cone}\bigl(1-s:\prod_nC_n\to\prod_nC_n\bigr)[-1]$, the termwise
products being exact and representing the product in the derived category
[lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact, lem-weil-derived-limit-existence].

**The operations.** Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and on sheaves of $(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules let
$f^*=f^{-1}(-)\otimes_{f^{-1}(A_{E,n})_Y}(A_{E,n})_X$ be the module inverse image
along the pro-etale inverse image $f^{-1}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]; it is
exact [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact], so applied termwise it computes the
derived pullback $L(f_n)^*$. For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and
$M,N\in D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, with resolutions $P\to K$, $P\to M$,
$Q\to N$ as above, define

$$
 Lf^*K=R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n f^*(P_n),
 \qquad
 M\mathbin{\widehat\otimes}^L_{\mathcal O_E}N
 =R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Res}_n\bigl(P_n\otimes_{(A_{E,n})_W}Q_n\bigr),
 \qquad
 R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_E}(M,N)
 =R\mathcal Hom_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}}(M,N),
$$

with the transition maps induced by $P_{n+1}\to P_n$ and $Q_{n+1}\to Q_n$. Here
$f^*(P_n)$ represents $L(f_n)^*K_n$, and $P_n\otimes_{(A_{E,n})_W}Q_n$ represents the
derived tensor product $M_n\otimes^L_{A_{E,n}}N_n$
[def-weil-derived-tensor], $P_n$ being K-flat. The first two are independent of the
resolutions up to unique isomorphism and are functors
$D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ and
$D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)^2\to D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$
[lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. The third is the derived internal Hom
[def-pur-derived-internal-hom] of the ringed site
$(W_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W})$, computed with a K-injective
resolution of $N$ in the category of all $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$-modules. The
first two are, respectively, the pullback followed by derived completion and the
completed tensor product of Bhatt--Scholze; that they agree with those (defined by
derived completion) on derived-complete objects is a comparison, not part of this
definition.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10 (completed tensor product) and Lemma 3.4.11 (R Hom into a complete object is complete; adjunction with the completed tensor product), p. 22; Lemma 3.4.12 (4) (a derived complete object is R lim of its reductions), p. 22; Section 6.5 setup (R-hat_X = lim R/m^n on X_proet) and Lemma 6.5.9 (4) (pullback followed by completion), pp. 49-50; with literature/stacks-project/proetale.tex, Lemma 099N (5) (proetale-lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case: Lf^*_comp M = R lim Lf^*(M ⊗^L Λ/I^n))

mathlib_searches.results: no derived (homotopy) limit in any triangulated or derived category; the only completed coefficient sheaf is `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ellAdicSheaf` (AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/ElladicCohomology.lean:63), the sheaf of abelian groups U ↦ C(U, ℤ_ℓ), with no ring or module structure and no derived category of modules over it

`Functor.totalLeftDerived` (CategoryTheory/Functor/Derived/LeftDerived.lean:193), an abstract left derived functor along a localization, and `Functor.mapDerivedCategory` (Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean:36) for exact functors; nothing for completed pullback or completed tensor products

split_report.summary: Lean state none on both branches; checked against Bhatt-Scholze Def. 3.4.10, Lemmas 3.4.11, 3.4.12(4), 6.5.9(4) (pp. 22, 49-50) and Stacks 099N(5). The definitions (R lim of the finite reductions for Lf^* and the completed tensor product; ambient R Hom over the completed sheaf) are kept; BS define these via derived completion, and the agreement is a comparison the statement now says is not part of the definition. Made the construction precise and named every notion: the reductions K_n are taken on a K-flat resolution with flat terms (lem-pc-kflat-resolution), whose reductions are K-flat over A_{E,n} (new lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings, Stacks 0G7E), so that M_n ⊗^L N_n is represented termwise and the transition maps exist at the level of complexes; the derived limit is represented by the shifted cone of 1-s on termwise products (lem-weil-proetale-countable-products-exact, lem-weil-derived-limit-existence). Replaced the claimed 'f^{-1} exact and f^{-1}(A_{E,n})_Y=(A_{E,n})_X' by the module inverse image f^* = f^{-1}(-) ⊗ (A_{E,n})_X, whose exactness is the existing prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact (so the definition does not need the identification of the constant sheaves). Independence of the resolutions and functoriality on the derived categories, which the old statement took for granted, is the new statement node lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined. Added lem-weil-restriction-of-scalars-exact, def-weil-integral-derived-reduction, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-kflat-complex; removed def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, which the statement does not use.
